cover.title: Reducing friction
cover.subtitle: Turning a task-driven experience into a user-driven one.

hero.title: Elevating the stargazer's journey
hero.photoAlt: A hand holds an iPhone showing the Unistellar app on the Eagle nebula observation screen, against a green gradient background.

contexte: In 2022, Unistellar, a leader in smart telescopes, underwent a full rebranding to solidify its market position.

principles.intro1: Unistellar is a tech-driven company where innovation meets technical excellence.
principles.intro2: To address this, I worked to build trust in UX methodologies and user feedback, achieving recurring successes that demonstrated its value.
principles.title: My design principles

items.title: Tangible
items.text: I focus on transforming abstract strategies into meaningful, human-centered products that solve real problems.

items.title: Empathy
items.text: Putting myself in the user's shoes drives creativity and allows me to explore perspectives different from my own.

items.title: Emotions
items.text: Effective design should engage users emotionally, serving as a powerful driver of success.

items.title: Essential
items.text: Prioritize essential user needs to deliver a clear, effortless experience.

quote.text: At first, I was excited to start, but now I feel completely lost and don't know where to go next.
quote.attribution: User during the initial usability study phase

impact.title: Design impact
impact.text: Our users were thrilled with the telescope's design but felt frustrated when trying to explore its features. We transformed this disappointment into satisfaction, simplifying the experience and increasing NPS by 45%.

insights.title: Insights
insights.intro1: Our initial assumption was that simplifying user flows could reduce frustration.
insights.intro2: By collecting feedback from multiple sources, we reinforced our understanding that improving guidance and reducing cognitive overload were key to enhancing the experience.

steps.text: Collaborate with the team to identify high-impact areas for innovation, ensuring efforts align with strategic goals.
Develop and test wireframe solutions with users, optimizing for measurable outcomes like reduced time to complete an action.
Generate solutions that integrate seamlessly into the product ecosystem, creating detailed implementation specifications.
Use qualitative feedback and quantitative KPIs (e.g., NPS, engagement rates) to measure success and inform future iterations.

items.title: Talk like your users
items.text: Vocabulary such as Azimuth, RA/DEC, or J2000 is unfamiliar to users and creates barriers to understanding.

items.title: Prioritising information
items.text: The lack of a clear information hierarchy prevents users from navigating effectively; structured content guides attention.

items.title: A guide for discovery
items.text: Faced with an overwhelming number of objects, users feel confused; curated suggestions eliminate the blank-page effect.

items.title: A stagnant experience
items.text: Once the action is triggered, no further interaction is possible — the user becomes passive.

items.title: Actions that inspire and engage
items.text: Some actions fail to connect emotionally or offer practical value, creating unnecessary frustration.

items.title: Quick insights at a glance
items.text: A lack of hierarchy in interaction zones leaves users confused about the action to complete.

items.title: Emotion guiding function
items.text: The page feels more like a remote control than an inspiring window into the universe.

items.title: Streamline main actions
items.text: Bring together and organize the page's key actions for a clearer and more intuitive experience.

items.title: Illustrations to support choice
items.text: Highlight the telescope's action instead of relying on a solution that classifies illustrations into categories no one understands.

items.title: Engage user with reward
items.text: Unlock images of objects as they are observed, along with their details, to spark curiosity.

stats.label: NPS rating
stats.text: A 45% increase in NPS over two years propelled our product into the 40+ score category, a standard for customer satisfaction.

stats.label: Users
stats.text: Through strategic design and product improvements, the application achieved an 800% increase in its user base over two years.

stats.label: Stars on stores
stats.text: Even with an 800% growth in users, the product retained a 4-star average rating in app stores.

takeaways.title: Key takeaways and outcomes
takeaways.intro1: Communicating features is as important as developing them. Clear communication prevents frustration and engages users.
takeaways.intro2: While usability adds simplicity, it can make design less noticeable, risking a loss of appeal. Early KPIs helped us detect and address user engagement issues effectively.

items.title: Communicate features effectively
items.text: Developing a feature is only half the journey; clear communication about its benefits and usage is equally essential to drive adoption.

items.title: Balance utility with visibility
items.text: While functionality is crucial, it often remains invisible to users. Visible elements help them perceive and appreciate its value.

items.title: Set clear, quantifiable goals
items.text: Defining measurable objectives before starting ensures that progress can be tracked effectively over time.
